text: As it was a hard matter to keep back the Athenians, who were vexed at the delay, and were eagerly bent to fight, he divided the whole multitude into eight parts, and arranged by lot that that part which had the white bean should have leave to feast and take their ease, while the other seven were fighting.
author: Plutarch
translation: John Dryden et al., rev. Arthur Hugh Clough, 1864
